project_name: Hindi Editorial Newsroom Admin CMS & AI Rewriter

latin_fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans / Inter (UI Controls & Navigation)

Rewritten_Pending_Publish.label: Rewritten - Pending Publish (पुनर्लिखित - प्रकाशन हेतु लंबित)

key_features_and_components.name: Header & Stats Bar
key_features_and_components.description: Top editorial bar showing total news count, pending review count, rewritten count, published count, and theme toggle.

key_features_and_components.name: Filter & Search Toolbar
key_features_and_components.description: Filter by status (All, Pending_Review, Rewritten_Pending_Publish, Published), category filter (National, Politics, Business, Tech, Sports), search by title/content, and 'Add New Article' button.

key_features_and_components.name: News Feed / Grid / Table View
key_features_and_components.description: Dense, clean editorial cards showing headline (Hindi Devanagari), original source snippet, timestamp, category tag, status badge, and primary action buttons.

key_features_and_components.name: AI Rewrite Action ('Approve for Rewrite')
key_features_and_components.description: Triggers cost-effective API or internal Devanagari journalistic rewriter service. Displays inline loading spinner with prompt status 'उच्च पत्रकारिता श्रेणी में रूपांतरण जारी...'.

key_features_and_components.name: Side-by-Side Comparison Drawer / Modal
key_features_and_components.description: Comprehensive split view comparing Original Headline & Content vs AI-Rewritten High-Standard Hindi Article. Includes diff highlights, word count, tone check metrics, accuracy validation badge ('100% Fact Preserved'), and instant 'Publish Now' action.

key_features_and_components.name: New Article Modal
key_features_and_components.description: Quick input form to seed or paste raw news items for review.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Ensure backend (`/backend/server.py`) implements clean endpoints: GET `/api/news`, POST `/api/news`, POST `/api/news/{id}/rewrite`, POST `/api/news/{id}/publish`.

2. In the backend rewrite logic, ensure the AI prompt enforces: 'उच्चतम पत्रकारिता श्रेणी (High Standard Journalistic Hindi), शून्य व्याकरण व मात्रा त्रुटि, मूल तथ्यों का 100% प्रतिधारण, कॉपीराइट निवारण हेतु पूर्ण शब्द रूपांतरण'. Use standard LLM call (e.g., gpt-4o-mini / emergent AI / internal pipeline with fallback) to keep operating costs low.

3. Seed rich initial news items in `Pending_Review`, `Rewritten_Pending_Publish`, and `Published` states covering National, Business, Technology, and World news in both Hindi & English source materials.
4. Front-end typography MUST load Google Fonts for Devanagari (`Noto Serif Devanagari` and `Rozha One`) so Devanagari matras render crisply.
5. Use Shadcn components (`Tabs`, `Dialog`, `Badge`, `Button`, `DropdownMenu`, `ScrollArea`, `Card`) heavily styled with dark editorial slate borders and subtle crimson/emerald accents.
6. Every action button and key container must strictly include `data-testid` attributes as specified.
